status: Implemented types verified against source. Native families are owned and emitted by node ztunnel; CMTC never re-exports them. source-implemented means collector code exists but scrape/real-traffic qualification is missing, so its panels stay planned. Planned types/meanings are proposed contracts to validate in each delivering story.

cmtc_apiserver_probe_success.meaning: Latest fresh safe API connectivity/TLS probe result.
cmtc_apiserver_probe_success.presentation: Mapped latest state/history; not application mTLS or cluster-wide health.

cmtc_certificate_rotation_failures_total.meaning: Failed certificate rotation attempts or terminal failures with an agreed retry/event boundary.
cmtc_certificate_rotation_failures_total.presentation: Failures/s and range increase; retries must not silently multiply terminal failure counts.

cmtc_cluster_ready.meaning: All required verified cluster gates satisfied for the current generation and freshness window.
cmtc_cluster_ready.presentation: Mapped status/table; no sum that hides one failed or missing required gate.

cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_bytes_total.meaning: skb byte lengths rejected by the deny-only audited TCX hook; not application payload or encrypted bytes.
cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_bytes_total.presentation: Bytes/s or selected-range increase; same pinned-map lifecycle as dropped packets.
cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_bytes_total.deployment: Explicit disposable lab opt-in only; absent when its DaemonSet is not installed. Source collector implemented; scrape/dashboard qualification is separate.
cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_bytes_total.qualification: Locally qualified on four selected ARM64 nodes at source 5b1bc205fee9c6bc999c7d545e23ac0ff6f29bf2: exact-map load/idle, metrics-only HTTP routes, source targets, fresh central remote-write samples, each cluster selection, absent-source checks and both-theme visual inspection. Deny-only audited-hook scope; not mTLS or Protected.

cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_packets_tota.meaning: Packets rejected by the explicit deny-only audited TCX hook; retransmits and non-HTTP traffic count separately.
cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_packets_tota.presentation: Packets/s and selected-range increase; never requests, connections, TLS failures or protection coverage. Counter persists across exact pinned-map adoption, resets on a new attachment/map.
cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_packets_tota.deployment: Explicit disposable lab opt-in only; absent when its DaemonSet is not installed. Source collector implemented; scrape/dashboard qualification is separate.
cmtc_datapath_fence_dropped_packets_tota.qualification: Locally qualified on four selected ARM64 nodes at source 5b1bc205fee9c6bc999c7d545e23ac0ff6f29bf2: exact-map load/idle, metrics-only HTTP routes, source targets, fresh central remote-write samples, each cluster selection, absent-source checks and both-theme visual inspection. Deny-only audited-hook scope; not mTLS or Protected.

cmtc_datapath_fence_quarantine_verified.meaning: A sample no older than 3 seconds verifies the exact committed deny attachment and frozen audited native chain. This is never Protected, mTLS or first-packet admission.
cmtc_datapath_fence_quarantine_verified.presentation: Latest per-cluster/node/direction state: 1 quarantine verified, 0 unverified; absent/down scrape stays unavailable. Counters omitted when unverified.
cmtc_datapath_fence_quarantine_verified.deployment: Explicit disposable lab opt-in only; absent when its DaemonSet is not installed. Source collector implemented; scrape/dashboard qualification is separate.
cmtc_datapath_fence_quarantine_verified.qualification: Locally qualified on four selected ARM64 nodes at source 5b1bc205fee9c6bc999c7d545e23ac0ff6f29bf2: exact-map load/idle, metrics-only HTTP routes, source targets, fresh central remote-write samples, each cluster selection, absent-source checks and both-theme visual inspection. Deny-only audited-hook scope; not mTLS or Protected.

cmtc_datapath_observer_bytes_total.meaning: skb byte lengths seen at the audited TCX hook before the native Cilium verdict; not application payload bytes.
cmtc_datapath_observer_bytes_total.presentation: Bytes/s or selected-range increase; no encryption inference.
cmtc_datapath_observer_bytes_total.deployment: Explicit disposable lab opt-in only; absent when its DaemonSet is not installed. Source collector implemented; scrape/dashboard qualification is separate.
cmtc_datapath_observer_bytes_total.qualification: Locally qualified on both selected ARM64 workers at source 5b1bc205fee9c6bc999c7d545e23ac0ff6f29bf2: native policy preservation, exact-map load/idle, metrics-only HTTP routes, source targets, fresh central remote-write samples, each cluster selection, actual map and Prometheus counter reset, absent-source checks and both-theme visual inspection. Pre-verdict observation only; not enforcement, mTLS or Protected.

cmtc_datapath_observer_packets_total.meaning: Packets seen at the one audited TCX hook before the native Cilium verdict; not forwarded packets, attempts, requests, TLS handshakes or mTLS.
cmtc_datapath_observer_packets_total.presentation: Packets/s or selected-range increase; observer process/attachment restart resets the counter.
cmtc_datapath_observer_packets_total.deployment: Explicit disposable lab opt-in only; absent when its DaemonSet is not installed. Source collector implemented; scrape/dashboard qualification is separate.
cmtc_datapath_observer_packets_total.qualification: Locally qualified on both selected ARM64 workers at source 5b1bc205fee9c6bc999c7d545e23ac0ff6f29bf2: native policy preservation, exact-map load/idle, metrics-only HTTP routes, source targets, fresh central remote-write samples, each cluster selection, actual map and Prometheus counter reset, absent-source checks and both-theme visual inspection. Pre-verdict observation only; not enforcement, mTLS or Protected.

cmtc_datapath_observer_ready.meaning: Fresh sample verifies the exact audited observer interface and native baseline chain. Zero is unverified, not an enforcement verdict.
cmtc_datapath_observer_ready.presentation: Latest per-cluster/node/direction state; absence remains unavailable. Observer counters are omitted when this is stale or zero.
cmtc_datapath_observer_ready.deployment: Explicit disposable lab opt-in only; absent when its DaemonSet is not installed. Source collector implemented; scrape/dashboard qualification is separate.
cmtc_datapath_observer_ready.qualification: Locally qualified on both selected ARM64 workers at source 5b1bc205fee9c6bc999c7d545e23ac0ff6f29bf2: native policy preservation, exact-map load/idle, metrics-only HTTP routes, source targets, fresh central remote-write samples, each cluster selection, actual map and Prometheus counter reset, absent-source checks and both-theme visual inspection. Pre-verdict observation only; not enforcement, mTLS or Protected.

cmtc_dual_encryption_probe_success.meaning: Latest fresh controlled probe verifies both workload mTLS and the configured node encryption layer.
cmtc_dual_encryption_probe_success.presentation: Mapped latest probe and state history; absence/staleness is unknown.

cmtc_enforcement_available.meaning: Whether CMTC can verify required datapath enforcement; always 0 in Observe mode.
cmtc_enforcement_available.presentation: Mapped Unavailable status for observed zero; missing telemetry stays unavailable.

cmtc_hostnetwork_pods_total.meaning: Current hostNetwork pod inventory; the old proposed _total suffix is misleading for a level.
cmtc_hostnetwork_pods_total.presentation: Use cmtc_pods_observed{network="host"} now; agree a gauge name before adding another exporter. Never rate() inventory.

cmtc_issuer_profile_acknowledged_valid_u.meaning: Lease expiry from this producer process's last acknowledged published output write; zero means no acknowledged write in this process or acknowledged withdrawal.
cmtc_issuer_profile_acknowledged_valid_u.presentation: Latest timestamp with stated local-process scope; compare clock separately. It is not actual consumer consumption, authorization or trust_bundle_ready. Lost-ack commits can exist while this gauge remains zero.
cmtc_issuer_profile_acknowledged_valid_u.qualification: Exact CMTC source7e606195f5/image/API/scrape qualified locally on both mesh clusters; fresh B-to-A remote-write verified. Optional producer only, absent when disabled. docs/evidence/issuer-profile-producer. Does not satisfy trust consumption, TLS or authorization metrics.

cmtc_issuer_profile_publication_writes_t.meaning: Output API Update responses, by bounded state published/withdrawn and result acknowledged/error. A lost response can count error even when the server committed; no global exactly-once count is claimed.
cmtc_issuer_profile_publication_writes_t.presentation: rate/increase by state/result. Unchanged reconcile does not increment. Retry re-reads output and avoids an extra write after an unknown acknowledgment; process restart resets.
cmtc_issuer_profile_publication_writes_t.qualification: Exact CMTC source7e606195f5/image/API/scrape qualified locally on both mesh clusters; fresh B-to-A remote-write verified. Optional producer only, absent when disabled. docs/evidence/issuer-profile-producer. Does not satisfy trust consumption, TLS or authorization metrics.

cmtc_issuer_profile_source_checked_times.meaning: Wall-clock timestamp of the last successful uncached configured-source API GET, including invalid or UID-mismatched objects.
cmtc_issuer_profile_source_checked_times.presentation: Latest timestamp/age by producer. It is not approval success, current consumer state or Ready; stale read age is unknown. Process restart starts at zero.
cmtc_issuer_profile_source_checked_times.qualification: Exact CMTC source7e606195f5/image/API/scrape qualified locally on both mesh clusters; fresh B-to-A remote-write verified. Optional producer only, absent when disabled. docs/evidence/issuer-profile-producer. Does not satisfy trust consumption, TLS or authorization metrics.

cmtc_issuer_profile_validation_attempts_.meaning: One opted-in producer pass result after exact API source-read, certificate/pin validation and final source-snapshot check. Retries count as attempts, not distinct security incidents.
cmtc_issuer_profile_validation_attempts_.presentation: rate/increase by bounded result accepted/rejected/unavailable; process restart resets. Owner is public issuer-profile producer, not TLS verifier.
cmtc_issuer_profile_validation_attempts_.qualification: Exact CMTC source7e606195f5/image/API/scrape qualified locally on both mesh clusters; fresh B-to-A remote-write verified. Optional producer only, absent when disabled. docs/evidence/issuer-profile-producer. Does not satisfy trust consumption, TLS or authorization metrics.

cmtc_issuer_ready.meaning: Expected issuer can provide a verifiable chain under a defined freshness/issuance check.
cmtc_issuer_ready.presentation: Mapped state/history; pod Ready or Issuer object presence is insufficient.

cmtc_mtls_active_connections.meaning: Currently active verified workload-mTLS connections, counted at one defined endpoint.
cmtc_mtls_active_connections.presentation: Latest value and line if it varies; no rate() or source-plus-destination sum.

cmtc_mtls_authorization_denials_total.meaning: Destination policy rejections at the authorization boundary.
cmtc_mtls_authorization_denials_total.presentation: rate() or range increase, split from identity failures and attempts; avoid double counting.

cmtc_mtls_handshake_duration_seconds.meaning: Actual workload TLS handshake duration in seconds at the TLS boundary.
cmtc_mtls_handshake_duration_seconds.presentation: p95/p99 from bucket rates grouped by cluster/le and bounded result; no average or TCP-counter substitute.

cmtc_mtls_handshakes_total.meaning: Completed actual TLS handshake observations, labeled by bounded result and one reporting boundary.
cmtc_mtls_handshakes_total.presentation: rate() by result; selected-range increase for totals; not TCP starts or HTTP requests.

cmtc_mtls_identity_validation_failures_t.meaning: Failed peer certificate/identity validation events at the verifier.
cmtc_mtls_identity_validation_failures_t.presentation: rate() by bounded reason or selected-range increase; not every plaintext attempt.

cmtc_mtu_validation_failures_total.meaning: Failed controlled MTU/MSS validation attempts for the selected encryption profile.
cmtc_mtu_validation_failures_total.presentation: Failures/s or range increase; preserve attempted-probe denominator separately.

cmtc_namespace_decisions.meaning: Current mutually exclusive selected/excluded/platform/unselected namespace decisions.
cmtc_namespace_decisions.presentation: Latest table and one pie of all observed namespaces; categories must exhaust one denominator.

cmtc_namespace_label_drift_total.meaning: Detected enrollment-label drift episodes under a defined deduplication boundary.
cmtc_namespace_label_drift_total.presentation: Event rate/range increase; not the number of namespaces currently drifting.

cmtc_namespace_policy_conflicts_total.meaning: Detected policy-conflict events under a defined deduplication boundary.
cmtc_namespace_policy_conflicts_total.presentation: Event rate/range increase; current conflict state needs its own gauge/condition.

cmtc_namespaces_eligible.meaning: Observed non-platform namespaces, including explicit exclusions.
cmtc_namespaces_eligible.presentation: Latest count/table; not safe-to-enroll or protection coverage.

cmtc_namespaces_enrolled.meaning: Namespaces bearing the enrollment label from any actor.
cmtc_namespaces_enrolled.presentation: Latest count/table; never label it protected.

cmtc_namespaces_excluded.presentation: Latest count; current view uses namespace_decisions{decision="excluded"}.

cmtc_namespaces_selected.meaning: Current namespace policy selection intent; Observe does not mutate labels.
cmtc_namespaces_selected.presentation: Latest count/table; not encrypted or protected namespaces.

cmtc_node_agent_ready.meaning: Successful local inventory observation, 0/1 per node.

cmtc_node_config_drift_total.meaning: Detected node desired/applied configuration drift episodes.
cmtc_node_config_drift_total.presentation: Event rate/range increase; current drift is a distinct status.

cmtc_plaintext_bypass_detected_total.meaning: A verifier observes unauthorized plaintext reaching a destination that requires mTLS.
cmtc_plaintext_bypass_detected_total.presentation: Incident rate/count; a plaintext attempt rejected by DENY is not a bypass.

cmtc_platform_dependency_healthy.meaning: Latest fresh platform dependency check, with a bounded dependency label.
cmtc_platform_dependency_healthy.presentation: Mapped table/status history per required dependency; missing dependency cannot pass aggregate readiness.

cmtc_pods_enforcement_failed.meaning: Current eligible pods in a failed enforcement state, not cumulative failure events.
cmtc_pods_enforcement_failed.presentation: Latest state count/table; never rate() this gauge.

cmtc_pods_observed.meaning: Node-local pod inventory split by pod/host network category.
cmtc_pods_observed.presentation: Latest table by cluster/node/network; no protection inference.

cmtc_pods_pending.meaning: Eligible current pods awaiting one or more required enforcement gates.
cmtc_pods_pending.presentation: Latest state count/table; exclusive with protected/failed states.

cmtc_pods_protected.meaning: Eligible current pods with fresh verified mandatory capture, identity and destination enforcement.
cmtc_pods_protected.presentation: Latest state count/table; no inference from enrollment or ACK.

cmtc_reconcile_errors_total.meaning: CMTC reconcile error events with a defined owner and retry counting boundary.
cmtc_reconcile_errors_total.presentation: Errors/s; current view uses actual controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_total instead of inventing an alias.

cmtc_remote_identity_cache_misses_total.meaning: Lookup misses in the authenticated remote workload identity cache.
cmtc_remote_identity_cache_misses_total.presentation: Misses/s; a miss alone is neither a rejected request nor a security breach.

cmtc_rollout_aborted_total.meaning: Aborted rollout events with bounded reason/profile labels.
cmtc_rollout_aborted_total.presentation: Aborts/s or selected-range increase; distinguish current rollout state.

cmtc_spire_ready.meaning: Fresh authenticated SPIRE API readiness acknowledgment at a defined boundary.
cmtc_spire_ready.presentation: Mapped state/history; separate API ACK from registration and workload issuance.

cmtc_transport_compatibility_ready.meaning: Selected Cilium/ClusterMesh/ztunnel/transport profile passes the required compatibility gates.
cmtc_transport_compatibility_ready.presentation: Mapped status/table per profile; not a count of encrypted packets.

cmtc_transport_encryption_failures_total.meaning: Observed required node-layer encryption failures at a defined probe/datapath boundary.
cmtc_transport_encryption_failures_total.presentation: Failures/s by bounded profile/reason; not an application TLS handshake counter.

cmtc_trust_bundle_ready.meaning: Required public bundle observed and consumed at the expected generation/digest with freshness.
cmtc_trust_bundle_ready.presentation: Mapped state/table; ConfigMap existence alone is insufficient.

cmtc_ztunnel_ready.meaning: Fresh proxy-process/configuration readiness at a stated boundary.
cmtc_ztunnel_ready.presentation: Mapped table/status history; proxy readiness alone does not establish Protected.

controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_tota.presentation: Errors/s over $__rate_interval; observed zero is valid.

controller_runtime_reconcile_time_second.meaning: Observed controller reconcile duration in seconds.
controller_runtime_reconcile_time_second.presentation: p95 from bucket rates aggregated by cluster/le; not TLS/network latency.

istio_tcp_connections_closed_total.meaning: TCP connections closed by node ztunnel with their response flag (- none, DENY policy, others transport/identity).
istio_tcp_connections_closed_total.presentation: Destination-reported selected-range increase partitions completed attempts into five exclusive outcomes; reporters must not be added together.
istio_tcp_connections_closed_total.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). Not yet scraped from cmtc-a/cmtc-b: ztunnel is OFF in the combined profile. The lab scrape job ztunnel is added in scripts/lab/monitoring.py; qualify it on the existing clusters before relying on these panels.

istio_tcp_connections_failed_total.meaning: TCP connections that failed to establish; response_flags=DENY is a ztunnel authorization rejection.
istio_tcp_connections_failed_total.presentation: Destination-reported DENY rate/increase is the native authorization-denial signal; it overlaps opens and must not be added to them.
istio_tcp_connections_failed_total.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). Not yet scraped from cmtc-a/cmtc-b: ztunnel is OFF in the combined profile. The lab scrape job ztunnel is added in scripts/lab/monitoring.py; qualify it on the existing clusters before relying on these panels.

istio_tcp_connections_opened_total.meaning: TCP connections opened through node ztunnel, labelled by reporter and by whether a peer certificate was verified (connection_security_policy=mutual_tls).
istio_tcp_connections_opened_total.presentation: Selected-range increase or rate, destination reporter for one count per connection; never TLS handshakes or HTTP requests.
istio_tcp_connections_opened_total.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). Not yet scraped from cmtc-a/cmtc-b: ztunnel is OFF in the combined profile. The lab scrape job ztunnel is added in scripts/lab/monitoring.py; qualify it on the existing clusters before relying on these panels.

istio_tcp_received_bytes_total.meaning: Application payload bytes received through ztunnel connections.
istio_tcp_received_bytes_total.presentation: Source-reported rate inside mutual_tls connections; payload bytes, not packets or encryption proof.
istio_tcp_received_bytes_total.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). Not yet scraped from cmtc-a/cmtc-b: ztunnel is OFF in the combined profile. The lab scrape job ztunnel is added in scripts/lab/monitoring.py; qualify it on the existing clusters before relying on these panels.

istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total.meaning: Application payload bytes sent through ztunnel connections.
istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total.presentation: Source-reported rate inside mutual_tls connections; payload bytes, not packets or encryption proof.
istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). Not yet scraped from cmtc-a/cmtc-b: ztunnel is OFF in the combined profile. The lab scrape job ztunnel is added in scripts/lab/monitoring.py; qualify it on the existing clusters before relying on these panels.

istio_tls_handshake_duration_seconds.meaning: Duration of successful workload TLS handshakes at the ztunnel TLS boundary, by reporter.
istio_tls_handshake_duration_seconds.presentation: p95 from bucket rates by cluster and le; no average.
istio_tls_handshake_duration_seconds.qualification: Collector implementation and local failure/recovery tests are pending; no live scrape evidence yet.

istio_tls_handshakes_total.meaning: Completed workload TLS handshakes at the ztunnel TLS boundary, by reporter (source client / destination server) and closed result success, peer_verification_failed, protocol_error or timeout.
istio_tls_handshakes_total.presentation: rate() by cluster and result; peer_verification_failed answers the identity-validation contract. Not TCP opens or HTTP requests.
istio_tls_handshakes_total.qualification: Collector implementation and local failure/recovery tests are pending; no live scrape evidence yet.

istio_xds_connection_terminations_total.meaning: Ended ztunnel ADS streams by reason.
istio_xds_connection_terminations_total.presentation: Rate by cluster; a burst marks reconnects or rejected updates, not ACK freshness.
istio_xds_connection_terminations_total.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). Not yet scraped from cmtc-a/cmtc-b: ztunnel is OFF in the combined profile. The lab scrape job ztunnel is added in scripts/lab/monitoring.py; qualify it on the existing clusters before relying on these panels.

workload_manager_active_proxy_count.meaning: In-pod proxies ztunnel currently holds from ZDS.
workload_manager_active_proxy_count.presentation: Latest per node; not mandatory capture, enrollment or an issued certificate.
workload_manager_active_proxy_count.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md). workload_manager_pending_proxy_count.meaning: In-pod proxies waiting for a ZDS snapshot.
workload_manager_pending_proxy_count.presentation: Latest per node; non-zero for long means ZDS delivery is stuck.
workload_manager_pending_proxy_count.qualification: Native ztunnel family measured with real authenticated/denied load in the retired isolated cmtc-mtls two-node fixture on 2026-10-24 (examples/observability/ztunnel-spike/METRICS_INVENTORY.md).
